_: Canonical constants for the workstream-S stat design (docs/world/76-stats-progression.md §116-129). Phase 10c ports this file to packages/game-core/src/stats/data/.

health._: maxHealth = attrCoefficient*(Str+End) + level*(levelBase + End/levelEnduranceDivisor). Continuous and retroactive.

stamina._: max = base + endCoefficient*End; regen/s = regenBase + regenAgiCoefficient*Agi after regenDelay.

carry._: capacityKg = base + strCoefficient*Str. Str 50 = 180 kg = today's sandbox capacity.

burdenTiers._: calibrated by the sim so the reference kit is mid and a full endgame plate kit is fat until Strength grows

mitigation._: mitigation = AR / (AR + constant + damageCoefficient*incomingDamage). AR 50 vs a 24 blow = today's 25.0 %.

softRequirement._: Shortfall d below an item requirement: never blocks, costs stamina and recovery.

breath._: seconds = base + athleticsCoefficient*Athletics + enduranceCoefficient*End; unlimited for water-breathers.

vastei._: per qualifying use = perUse * worthiness * (1 + effSkill/skillDivisor)

levelUp._: 10 major/minor ranks = one pending level; misc ranks count 3:1 once majors/minors are maxed.
